change_summary: Added an execution-date cash ledger to quant/backtester.py behind CASH_LEDGER_ENFORCED (default False, byte-identical baselines): core entries/add-ons debit booked basis and are deterministically scaled/skipped when enforced; exits and partial reduces release basis plus pnl; every result now carries a cash_ledger audit with exact conservation checks. Frozen-input replay proved Gate-1 identity with the flag off, zero negative-cash events with it on, and quantified the champion's overdraft: 17-18 negative-cash events per window, peak overdrafts -166.6k/-188.6k/-188.5k on 100k initial, honest re-measurement EV 12.2698->6.2057 (-49.4%), PnL 237,852->130,992.

hypothesis: The canonical core backtester books entry and add-on fills with no execution-date cash constraint, producing 18-20 negative-cash events per canonical window and up to -23,234 USD reconstructed overdraft on 100,000 USD initial capital (exp-20260715-005 dated-ledger audit); enforcing an execution-date cash ledger with deterministic scale-down or rejection of unaffordable core entries and add-ons, and cash release on exits and partial reduces, repairs this production/backtest parity defect and re-baselines the canonical windows on executable capital only.
notes: Measurement repair accepted on its own acceptance rule (all six machine checks passed); status recorded via override because the EV/PnL delta is the honest de-leveraged re-measurement, not a strategy regression. Default flip + canonical re-baseline is an explicit follow-up ticket. Unenforced champion comparisons (exp-20260715-002/005 style displacement tests) are biased against challengers.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not re-tune the enforcement (partial-fill vs reject policy, cash buffer thresholds, per-order caps) and do not reserve another audit-only quantification of the same overdraft surface; the phenomenon is now measured and machine-checked in-engine on every run.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Follow-up ticket for the canonical decision: flip CASH_LEDGER_ENFORCED to True by default, republish a frozen-input post-cash-ledger Gate-1 anchor (exp-20260712-015 pattern), and re-open the parked capital-allocation lanes (low_deployment ETF overlay, portfolio covariance) whose displacement math was biased by the unenforced champion. Any live claim additionally needs the production runner's actual cash/sizing semantics compared against the backtest scale-down rule.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The inline ledger sees add-on fills and marked-value position sizing compounding: the champion books up to ~189k more entry basis than settled cash at peaks (8x deeper than exp-20260715-005's closed-rows reconstruction), so enforcing executable cash removes roughly half the canonical PnL; old_thin EV nearly vanishes (1.31->0.11).

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260715-005 dated ledger already quantified the overdraft with zero NAV reconciliation errors; the repair is deterministic bookkeeping at four known mutation points in backtester.py; main risk is magnitude of champion re-baselining, not correctness.
